preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of events m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 for t, *args in events)
preconditions.description: Each event type t is either 1, 2, or 3.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for t, x, *args in events if t in (1, 2, 3))
preconditions.description: Employee numbers x in events are between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y <= n for t, x, y in events if t == 1)
preconditions.description: Employee numbers y in boss assignment events are between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= packet_count for t, x, i in events if t == 3)
preconditions.description: Packet numbers i in query events are between 1 and the number of packets given so far inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i-1] in ('YES', 'NO') for i, (t, x, i) in enumerate(events) if t == 3)
postconditions.description: Each query of the third type results in either 'YES' or 'NO'.
